Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.context

package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.context
Declarative, action-bound context-menu contracts.

Plugins describe locations, semantic selections, entry trees, and placement using Turboism-owned values. Runtime adapters own host menu objects, native event translation, exact-version provider admission, and UI-thread handling. The context-menu permission allows a contribution request but does not guarantee that a real-host provider is available; fake or recorded contributions are not host-readiness evidence.
